glosses: the bank of seats at the ends of a football/soccer pitch

examples.text: La strada curva dolcemente verso ovest.
examples.en: The road curves gently towards the west.

examples.text: La strada curva leggermente verso il lago.
examples.en: The road curves gently toward the lake.

examples.text: La strada prosegue dritta per circa un chilometro e poi c'è una curva.
examples.en: The road goes straight for about a kilometer and then turns.
